title: Cloud API Rate Limit and Throttling (429) Trends

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Splunk TAs for each cloud (CloudTrail, Activity Log, GCP audit) with the modular input for `aws:cloudtrail`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.4.33.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Search audit logs for throttling errors (AWS ThrottlingException, Azure 429, GCP RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED). Dashboard by API and principal. Request quota increase when sustained. Consider exponential backoff and request batching in applications.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" errorCode="ThrottlingException"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress awsRegion
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.4.10_cloud_api_rate_limit_and_10"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cloudtrail` in `index=aws` to detect cloud api rate limit and throttling (429) trends. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS CloudTrail console Event history for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_4_10_alert` with severity aligned to `medium` criticality. Dashboard: Table (API, principal, 429 count), Line chart (429 over time), Bar chart (top throttled APIs)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk TAs for each cloud (CloudTrail, Activity Log, GCP audit) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of cloud api rate limit and throttling (429) trends so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
